description: Apache Maven, a software project management tool.

next.name: clean
tip: Remove all files generated by the previous build.

next.name: compile
tip: Compile the source code of the project.

next.name: compiler:compile
tip: Compile the main source code.

next.name: compiler:testCompile
tip: Compile the test source code.

next.name: dependency:resolve
tip: Resolve and download the project's dependencies.

next.name: dependency:tree
tip: Print the project's dependency tree.

next.name: deploy
tip: Copy the final package to the remote repository for sharing with other developers and projects.

next.name: exec:exec
tip: Run an external program.

next.name: exec:java
tip: Run a Java main class in the same JVM.

next.name: failsafe:integration-test
tip: Run integration tests with the Failsafe plugin.

next.name: help:describe
tip: Describe a plugin, a goal, or a lifecycle.

next.name: help:effective-pom
tip: Print the effective POM after merging and interpolation.

next.name: install
tip: Install the package into the local repository, for use as a dependency in other projects locally.

next.name: jar:jar
tip: Package the compiled classes into a JAR.

next.name: package
tip: Take the compiled code and package it in its distributable format, such as a JAR.

next.name: post-clean
tip: Execute processes needed to finalize the project cleaning.

next.name: post-site
tip: Execute processes needed to finalize the site generation and prepare for site deployment.

next.name: pre-clean
tip: Execute processes needed prior to the actual project cleaning.

next.name: pre-site
tip: Execute processes needed prior to the actual project site generation.

next.name: shade:shade
tip: Build a fat JAR bundling the project and all its dependencies.

next.name: site
tip: Generate the project's site documentation.

next.name: site-deploy
tip: Deploy the generated site documentation to the specified web server.

next.name: surefire:test
tip: Run unit tests with the Surefire plugin.

next.name: test
tip: Run tests using a suitable unit testing framework. These tests should not require the code be packaged or deployed.

next.name: validate
tip: Validate the project is correct and all necessary information is available.

next.name: verify
tip: Run any checks to verify the package is valid and meets quality criteria.

next.name: war:war
tip: Package the project into a WAR.

option.name: --show-version
tip: Display version information WITHOUT stopping build.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

global_option.name: --activate-profiles
tip: Comma-delimited list of profiles to activate.

global_option.name: --also-make
tip: If project list is specified, also build projects required by the list.

global_option.name: --also-make-dependents
tip: If project list is specified, also build projects that depend on projects on the list.

global_option.name: --batch-mode
tip: Run in non-interactive (batch) mode.

global_option.name: --builder
tip: The id of the build strategy to use.

global_option.name: --check-plugin-updates
tip: Ineffective, only kept for backward compatibility.

global_option.name: --color
tip: Defines the color mode of the output.

global_option.name: --debug
tip: Produce execution debug output.

global_option.name: --define
tip: Define a user property.

next.name: maven.test.skip
tip: Skip compiling and running the test sources.

next.name: skipTests
tip: Skip running the tests, but still compile the test sources.

global_option.name: --encrypt-master-password
tip: Encrypt master security password.

global_option.name: --encrypt-password
tip: Encrypt server password.

global_option.name: --errors
tip: Produce execution error messages.

global_option.name: --fail-at-end
tip: Only fail the build afterwards; allow all non-impacted builds to continue.

global_option.name: --fail-fast
tip: Stop at first failure in reactorized builds.

global_option.name: --fail-never
tip: NEVER fail the build, regardless of project result.

global_option.name: --file
tip: Force the use of an alternate POM file.

global_option.name: --global-settings
tip: Alternate path for the global settings file.

global_option.name: --global-toolchains
tip: Alternate path for the global toolchains file.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display help information.

global_option.name: --ignore-transitive-repositories
tip: If set, Maven will ignore remote repositories introduced by transitive dependencies.

global_option.name: --lax-checksums
tip: Warn if checksums don't match.

global_option.name: --log-file
tip: Log file where all build output will go.

global_option.name: --no-plugin-registry
tip: Ineffective, only kept for backward compatibility.

global_option.name: --no-plugin-updates
tip: Ineffective, only kept for backward compatibility.

global_option.name: --no-snapshot-updates
tip: Suppress SNAPSHOT updates.

global_option.name: --no-transfer-progress
tip: Do not display transfer progress when downloading or uploading.

global_option.name: --non-recursive
tip: Do not recurse into sub-projects.

global_option.name: --offline
tip: Work offline.

global_option.name: --projects
tip: Comma-delimited list of specified reactor projects to build.

global_option.name: --quiet
tip: Quiet output - only show errors.

global_option.name: --raw-streams
tip: Ignored (Maven4 option).

global_option.name: --resume-from
tip: Resume reactor from specified project.

global_option.name: --settings
tip: Alternate path for the user settings file.

global_option.name: --strict-checksums
tip: Fail the build if checksums don't match.

global_option.name: --threads
tip: Thread count, for instance 4 (int) or 2C/2.5C (int/float).

global_option.name: --toolchains
tip: Alternate path for the user toolchains file.

global_option.name: --update-plugins
tip: Ineffective, only kept for backward compatibility.

global_option.name: --update-snapshots
tip: Forces a check for missing releases and updated snapshots on remote repositories.
